Name: Shelomith, Son of Zichri
Summary: Son of Zichri, over all the treasures of the dedicated things with his brethren.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:25: Son of Zichri, over all the treasures of the dedicated things with his brethren.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shelomith stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
